description: Fetch a session's log content from one agent run. part=session is the agent stream-json (reasoning + tool calls); part=system is the container/runner stdout (clone, dependency install, validation gate, git, callback); part=prompt is the assembled input prompt. The role and sessionId are fields of the agent run's own record. A log longer than 40,000 characters returns its end, from a whole line, with a note.

role.description: Agent role: planner | builder | reviewer | qa

sandboxId.description: Agent run id: the run's sandbox id

sessionId.description: Session id from get_agent_run's sessions list

name: get_agent_run_logs
title: Get agent run logs
